note: Tennessee State Parks, near the Mississippi line in West Tennessee. Small primitive campground in hardwood forest. CLOSED FOR RENOVATIONS with no reopening date (park camping page, 2026-11-25); only backcountry shelters and group sites 2 and 3 open meanwhile. Travis McNatt Lake also closed for infrastructure work. --Claude
summary: Big Hill Pond: park camping page, booking calendar, OSM, Esri read. Still closed for renovations, no reopen date (agrees with the manual status). 28 primitive sites, no hookups, bathhouse with showers, no dump. Rate unread (calendar shows no prices while closed). Page says 'Most sites will accommodate a trailer up to 20 feet' but the calendar posts 24+ ft on 22 sites. Not waterfront confirmed.
